CustomField.description: Defines whether Contact__c holds a legal role within the supplier's organization, and defines certain permissions granted to him/ her for the related Negoscope__c. By default in Connect, a contact who has Primary or Secondary legal role in COD will be able to gain access to records related to the Negoscope in the following objects : Negoscopes, Sales Terms Exceptions, NegoptimFile__c (RT = Contract, Sales Terms, Objection_Letter, Purchasing_Terms)
CustomField.label: Legal Role
